Transport Documents

Einfuhranmeldung

A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Einfuhranmeldung?

In this glossary, Einfuhranmeldung refers to: A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

How is Einfuhranmeldung used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Der Importeur füllte die Einfuhranmeldung elektronisch aus, bevor die Waren zur Zollabfertigung an der Landesgrenze eintrafen."

Why does Einfuhranmeldung matter in logistics?

Einfuhranmeldung matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Einfuhranmeldung?

Einfuhranmeldung is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Einfuhranmeldung belong to?

In this glossary, Einfuhranmeldung is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Operational example

The importer completed the import declaration electronically before the goods arrived at the national border for customs clearance.

Localized term

Einfuhranmeldung

Localized example

Der Importeur füllte die Einfuhranmeldung elektronisch aus, bevor die Waren zur Zollabfertigung an der Landesgrenze eintrafen.
